name: Grilled rattan shoot
summary: A rattan shoot from deep forest, grilled until it is bitter and fragrant. You dip it in salt pounded with plenty of xiêm chili, hot and bitter in its own right.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls đọt mây an Êđê specialty, grilled and dipped in chili salt.
howToEat: Êđê cooks also reach for it after heavy drinking and for a bloated stomach.
seoTitle: Dot may nuong — grilled rattan shoot
seoDescription: Bitter, fragrant rattan shoot from deep forest, grilled and dipped in xiem-chili salt.
taste: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 calls the shoot bitter and fragrant, and the chili salt bitter and hot.
